reviews.text:
The staff loves animals and is kind and affectionate.
I had my dog ​​washed after being taken from a shelter. He was very scared, but they did a great job calming him down with gentle caresses and hugs.

Dirty, smelly place, no ventilation. We brought our cat, and he groomed her for less than 15 minutes; I'd rather do that at home. Plus, while there were two or three dogs roaming the place, the cat was terrified. For goodness sake, never again!
We have been relying on Beatrice and her staff for more than 10 years now, with great satisfaction, to provide our dogs with beauty care.

I always bring my dog ​​here, and I've always found them very courteous and professional!
I trust these girls because my dog ​​is calm and when he goes out, he's truly beautiful 🥰 He even looks like a puppy again. …

Today, Mrs. Daniela groomed my 16-year-old senior dog, who unfortunately has several health conditions and tends to get very agitated, especially during bath time, partly due to his heart problems.

I want to emphasize her extraordinary kindness, infinite patience, and the great sensitivity with which she managed every moment, respecting my dog's time and needs without ever forcing him. In such a delicate situation, Daniela proved herself not only to be an attentive and competent professional, but above all a truly human and kind person.

She instilled calm and trust in both him and me, treating him with rare and precious care. For anyone who has an elderly and fragile pet, finding someone like her is truly a blessing. Thank you so much, Daniela.

I always bring my cats here and I've always had a great experience. Beatrice is a very professional person and you can immediately tell she has years of experience. The girls are also all good and kind, the products are of excellent quality.
Very helpful staff

I took my dog ​​to this groomer. The staff was incredibly kind, attentive, and professional. They immediately made my dog ​​feel at ease.
The environment is clean and meticulously cared for. I'll definitely be back and highly recommend it to anyone who wants the best for their pets.
Terrible: mistreatment of poor little dogs and low-quality products that cause skin sores.
They are also very good at handling large dogs.

If I could, I'd give it 0 stars. They keep my dog ​​for hours and hours (we're talking 3 hours for a cut and wash, while other places take 1 hour). The owner shows up 3 times, not even half. The dogs are treated roughly, which is obvious from the outside. The only reason people go there is because it's close to their homes, something almost everyone in the neighborhood knows.
My cat was very happy to be washed and combed
The staff is no longer polite and friendly since they replaced someone who behaves in an arrogant and rude way with the risk that he might vent on the 🐕. …

I brought my dachshund Cosimo here for the first time last week, and I'll always come here. They're super kind and knowledgeable.

Thank you ☺️

I've been going to this grooming salon for several years, and I can say with certainty how much dogs are loved here. Beatrice, the owner, is extremely knowledgeable, attentive, and caring with her furry clients; she has extraordinary technical skills. Thanks also to all the staff, always kind and helpful. Thank you all! 🩷🩵 …

It was my first time at this salon... I'd say the girls were highly competent, from the welcome, to the washing, drying, and cutting by Beatrice Super...
A serious, serene environment, a great discovery... Congratulations from little Cry🐾 and Manuel...
See you soon 😊 …
Kindness and professionalism reign supreme at this grooming salon! Prices are average, but the results are well worth the expense. Thank you!
Maximum professionalism and kindness
I've been going to Beatrice for years, first to shave my cat and then to wash my dog, and I'm very happy with it!!!
Good and cheap.

I've always taken my dogs here and I'm really happy with the quality, expertise, and fair prices.
But above all, the work is done with passion and respect for our four-legged friends.
Furthermore, there are no parking issues since the area is very quiet and close to all amenities.
The staff were kind and attentive. I brought a 6-year-old dog for the first time. She was thoroughly washed and pampered, and left smelling wonderful. We were very happy. We'll be back soon. 😊 …

Fantastic staff, clean environment, my Chihuahua is super clean and smells great.
100% top professionalism.
